one_sentence: DOI 10.1111/ecoj.12593 resolves to Stock & Watson (2018), 'Identification and Estimation of Dynamic Causal Effects in Macroeconomics Using External Instruments,' The Economic Journal 128(610): 917-948, and every field in the entry matches the canonical record exactly.

issues.reason: Minor BibTeX hygiene only, not a factual error: no publisher field is present. At the time of this 2018 volume, The Economic Journal was still published by Wiley-Blackwell (the Royal Economic Society's journals moved to Oxford University Press only from the 2019 volume onward, per RES's own announcement), so 'Wiley-Blackwell' would be the historically accurate value if a publisher is added; current landing page is hosted at academic.oup.com post-migration. Several sibling .bib entries in this same bibliography include a publisher field and others do not, so this is a style-consistency nicety, not a correctness issue.
